news.headline: Travis Kelce passes Rob Gronkowski on TDs by TE list, alone in third all time

news.headline: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce's top moments at Arrowhead Stadium
news.description: Kelce's greatest Arrowhead moments include his first catch, lots of playoff magic, and meeting the love of his life, Taylor Swift.

news.headline: Week 11 betting preview: Analysis, best bets, TD predictions for Sunday

news.headline: Sources: Bucs' Baker Mayfield has plantar fasciitis, determined to keep playing

news.headline: Kirk Cousins on pace to make history as 1st QB to play 18 regular-season games
news.description: Vikings quarterback Kirk Cousins is poised to become the first quarterback in the modern era to play 18 regular-season games.

news.headline: Sources: Ex-Colts QB Daniel Jones likely to wait before signing with new team
news.description: If Daniel Jones clear waivers and becomes a free agent, the QB is unlikely to sign immediately, preferring to wait for the right opportunity, sources said.

news.headline: How Patriots' top 10 earners have fared: A.J. Brown, Christian Gonzalez, more
news.description: The Patriots' 5-5 record reflects what happens when a team's highest-paid players don't perform well. Let's look closer at the top 10 earners in New England.

news.headline: Cardinals rule out rookie Carson Beck, turn to 40-year-old Josh Johnson vs. Chiefs

news.headline: Steelers activate WR Roman Wilson off IR for Eagles game

news.headline: Carmelo Anthony calls out Ravens' Humphrey over Baltimore 'criminals' remark

news.headline: Back at practice again, Bengals QB Burrow optimistic he'll be at full strength

news.headline: Falcons insist winning still the goal despite trading Jessie Bates III

news.headline: In Mexico City, 49ers' Fred Warner can represent his heritage and boost DPOY case
news.description: Warner will represent his heritage again Sunday in Mexico City. This time while in the middle of the best Defensive Player of the Year campaign of his career.

class.pinned_note: Derek's call: an immediate dynasty WR4 when he arrives (2026-10-06). Always the 1.01 in every mock, whoever holds the pick (2026-11-17).

build.name: Pick Hoarder
build.about: An outsized share of value sits in draft picks.
plan: Picks lose value as the draft nears unless they're early; know which ones to use and which to flip.
Turn late firsts into young players who already produce.
Package several picks to move up for a top-three pick in a strong class.

build.name: All-In Veterans
build.about: Built to win this year on older starters; the window is one or two seasons.
plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut

Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.
